authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 337 Local Planning Authority administrative boundaries in England. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate authority records was considered solely for resolving the fixed slot partition/geography. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA entity/reference, local-authority code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector that can bind any candidate authority boundary to this slot. Choosing an authority would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
